title: First light, first pour
description: A 15 second vertical teaser for a small-batch coffee roaster: dawn mood, tactile close-ups, one clear call to action.
creativeGuidance: Warm, slow, tactile. No faces. Let steam and light carry it. Text short and confident.
style: cinematic macro photography, warm golden morning light, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain

audio.musicPrompt: warm lo-fi acoustic guitar and soft brushed drums, calm morning mood, 80 bpm, instrumental

scenes.description: Coffee beans tumbling out of a roaster drum in slow motion
scenes.prompt: Slow motion macro shot of freshly roasted coffee beans tumbling out of a copper roaster drum, wisps of smoke, warm sunrise light through a window

scenes.description: Pour-over: hot water spirals onto ground coffee, bloom rises
scenes.prompt: Close-up of hot water poured in a slow spiral onto ground coffee in a ceramic pour-over dripper, the coffee bed blooms and bubbles, steam rising, golden backlight

scenes.description: Steaming cup on a wooden table by a sunny window, camera pushes in
scenes.prompt: Slow push-in on a steaming cup of black coffee on a worn oak table beside a sunlit window, dust motes in the light, cosy morning atmosphere
